title: Outline feature properties, version 1
description: Properties every feature in outlines/<record-id>.geojson carries. Geometry is WGS84 (EPSG:4326). A feature is one wellbore (Point), one survey (Polygon) or one line (LineString).

approximate.description: true when the geometry is a placeholder (centroid, hand-drawn box) and not derived from the data; the map draws it differently and L3 requires false

source.description: How the geometry was derived: 'publisher shapefile <url>', 'LAS header lat/long', 'SEG-Y trace headers hull', 'hand placed from publisher map'

publisher_id.description: The publisher's own identifier for the wellbore or survey
